body:
AutoTune FPS is part of our goal to build the Minecraft optimization setup players actually need: easy enough for normal players, useful enough for advanced players, and cleaner than stacking a messy pile of separate performance mods.
AutoTune FPS is the main performance mod in the AutoTune Mods ecosystem.
It focuses on real Minecraft performance features, including smart presets, an Optimization Engine, Particle Reduction, proof counters, clear labels/tooltips, and practical FPS-focused controls.
AutoTune Core is the shared foundation for config, presets, metadata, recommendation logic, proof counters, labels, tooltips, compatibility helpers, and future AutoTune mods.
AutoTune FPS contains the actual Minecraft performance behavior, loader/version hooks, optimization modules, screens, commands, and FPS-focused controls.
Community: https://reddit.com/r/AutoTuneMC
Use the community for support, bug reports, feature ideas, compatibility reports, performance results, and update discussion.
